run_explore_smoke_test: run a pytest smoke test that calls explore.main with llvm-ic-v0 env and cbench-v1/dijkstra benchmark
test_explore_main_with_actions: test explore.main with specific explore_actions like newgvn, instcombine, and mem2reg passes
run_parallel_exhaustive_search: run a parallelized exhaustive search of compiler action space using explore.main with nproc threads
test_explore_episode_length: test the explore module by running explore.main with a short episode_length of 2 steps
run_explore_with_benchmark: run explore.main against a specific benchmark such as cbench-v1/dijkstra with configurable actions
